ag_absent.explanation: The complete CHAT_TRANSLATIONS table contains no entry for this exact input/output protocol pair. Provider branding or an OpenAI-compatible vendor endpoint does not supply the missing native conversion.

ais_ingress.explanation: The pinned router registers Chat, Responses and Messages among these six wire protocols. It has no native Gemini generateContent, Cohere chat, or Bedrock Converse ingress handler.

ais_cohere.explanation: The configured OpenAI provider emits Chat Completions; AISIX has no native Cohere upstream adapter in this release. An OpenAI-compatible Cohere-hosted endpoint is not the native Cohere wire.

ais_response.explanation: Chat and Messages ingress use Chat adapters for the OpenAI backend. Native Responses dispatch is attached to Responses ingress; no reverse Chat/Messages-to-Responses adapter is selected by this release.

api_ingress.explanation: Native Gemini/Cohere protocol handlers are absent from the AI protocol registry. Generic HTTP passthrough does not establish a native AI provider adapter or cross-protocol conversion.

api_gemini.explanation: The Gemini provider declares only openai-chat capability at /v1beta/openai/chat/completions; it does not emit native generateContent.

api_cohere.explanation: The AI protocol registry has no Cohere dialect; its converter registry cannot produce Cohere native chat.

api_cross.explanation: The complete inference converter registry only adds Anthropic Messages to OpenAI Chat. This non-diagonal pair is absent; embeddings conversion is outside this matrix.

bf_limit.explanation: Bedrock request construction hardcodes HTTPS. The common mock serves plain HTTP; no TLS bridge or gateway source modification is permitted here. These cells are rig-limited, not unsupported.

gm_ingress.explanation: The server registers Chat, Messages, Responses and provider passthrough. Native Gemini/Bedrock ingress is not registered, and these upstream adapters do not supply native passthrough interfaces in the audited release.

gm_cohere.explanation: Cohere ingress uses provider-native passthrough without translating its request or response. It can serve its own diagonal, not cross-protocol upstream columns.

gm_openai.explanation: CompatibleProvider sends Chat/Messages work to /chat/completions and Responses work to /responses. This opposite-operation cell does not select the requested wire; there is no operation selector for these OpenAI methods.

he_ingress.explanation: The unified router accepts Chat Completions only. Direct provider proxy paths expose their own native APIs; no native Responses, Gemini generateContent or Cohere interface is defined. Google uses OpenAI compatibility.

he_cross.explanation: Anthropic/Bedrock ingress is provider-prefixed native passthrough. The unified conversion entry point is OpenAI Chat; the native proxy route does not route this request to a different provider protocol.

he_egress.explanation: No native Responses or Cohere endpoint is defined; Google endpoint uses v1beta/openai/chat/completions, not native Gemini. The requested upstream dialect is absent.

hi_cross.explanation: The AI proxy auto-converts Messages through Chat where needed, but has no general conversion entry point for native Responses, Gemini, Cohere or Bedrock ingress. Their native passthrough supports matching diagonals only.

hi_response.explanation: The proxy has Responses passthrough but does not implement a Chat/Messages-to-Responses or Responses-to-other-protocol bridge.

hi_mantle.explanation: Messages-to-Bedrock dispatch selects /anthropic/v1/messages on Bedrock Mantle, not the Bedrock Converse wire that defines this matrix column. This is different product support, not a failed Converse request.

kong_ingress.explanation: The pinned ai-proxy schema allows only openai, bedrock and gemini input/output formats. Native Responses, Anthropic Messages and Cohere ingress are not options in this deployment.

kong_native.explanation: Schema validation restricts native Gemini and Bedrock llm_format to their matching provider; cross-provider conversion for this native ingress is not permitted.

kong_response.explanation: The ai-proxy schema supports OpenAI chat/completion operations, not OpenAI Responses. Provider name OpenAI does not imply the Responses operation.

lp_cross.explanation: Native Cohere/Bedrock ingress is served by provider-prefixed passthrough endpoints. Those routes forward the provider-native API; they are not universal cross-protocol conversion entry points.

lr_ingress.explanation: The standalone Rust router registers Chat, Responses and Messages inference entry points, with no Gemini, Cohere or Bedrock native ingress among these six dialects.

lr_chat_absent.explanation: The standalone Chat provider dispatch supports OpenAI-like Chat, Anthropic Messages and Bedrock Converse. There is no Responses, Gemini or Cohere target in this dispatch.

lr_responses_absent.explanation: The standalone Responses preparation selects the OpenAI Responses adapter; it does not bridge this request to the other matrix upstream dialects.

lr_messages_absent.explanation: The Messages provider dispatch has native Anthropic-family APIs, not Chat/Responses/Gemini/Cohere translations. Its Bedrock adapter invokes Anthropic on Bedrock rather than the Converse API.

oa_ingress.explanation: The relay router only exposes OpenAI Chat among the six matrix ingress protocols. The missing native API route cannot be inferred from an authentication/error status.

oa_response.explanation: The release predates a Responses relay route/adapter and only offers OpenAI Chat for this inference path. No Chat-to-Responses adapter is registered.

oa_limit.explanation: The AWS adapter constructs its SDK client with region/credentials and no mock endpoint override; its model invocation API also differs from the local Converse mock. The rig cannot exercise it, so this is not a missing Bedrock product-support claim.

pl_ingress.explanation: SupportedAPIsFromClient enumerates Chat, Responses and Messages only. No Gemini, Cohere or Bedrock native client API is defined.

pl_gemini.explanation: ProviderId::Gemini is dispatched through OpenAI-compatible Chat; it does not emit native Gemini generateContent.

pl_cohere.explanation: ProviderId and its provider parser contain no Cohere provider; no native Cohere upstream adapter is available.

pl_operation.explanation: compatible_api_for_client maps this provider/client combination to another operation: OpenAI preserves Chat/Responses and Messages-to-Chat; Anthropic serves native Messages only for Messages ingress. The requested exact wire pairing is absent.

pk_native.explanation: Native Gemini/Cohere/Bedrock ingress goes through raw proxy routing. It preserves the native protocol and has no conversion to this different upstream.

pk_response.explanation: OpenAI Chat and Responses are separate provider operations. This ingress does not select Responses, or the requested backend has no createModelResponse operation; the native Responses route is not a universal translation layer.

pk_messages.explanation: Messages translation is registered for Anthropic and Bedrock. The OpenAI/Cohere provider operation tables lack messages conversion, and native Gemini has no Messages converter.

tz_ingress.explanation: The OpenAI-compatible router exposes only /openai/v1/chat/completions. TensorZero native /inference is a different API and is outside the six-wire matrix.

tz_cohere.explanation: The complete provider module registry contains no Cohere provider, so Chat cannot emit the Cohere native wire.

tz_limit.explanation: The Gemini provider constructs public googleapis.com URLs internally, with no api_base override in this provider. The shared local mock cannot substitute for it; this is a rig limitation.

failures.explanation: The released Chat-to-Responses bridge emits GenericResponseOutputItem containing nonempty text. Its Responses-to-Anthropic adapter accepts only OpenAI SDK output-message objects or dicts, silently discarding the bridge object. Isolated reproduction in the pinned image with networking disabled reproduces content:[] without any running mock or benchmark server.
failures.workaround_policy: Global bridge override removed; no output conversion patch applied.

failures.explanation: The Converse adapter maps OpenAI max_tokens to provider maxTokens, but unsupported_param validates provider-side names against the untranslated request before transform_request. The canonical max_tokens:64 request is rejected with 501 before any upstream request. An exploratory request without the limit reached the Converse mock, proving the route exists; removing that limit from the benchmark is prohibited.
failures.workaround_policy: Keep max_tokens and the supported cell; no drop-parameter option.

failures.explanation: Cohere DefaultCapabilities advertises Chat completion and its request converter produces valid native /v1/chat input. The provider implements no TransformResponseBodyHandler. main.go therefore retains raw Cohere JSON, which is not the OpenAI Chat response promised to the client. The response contains text ok, so this is response-format failure, not absent model output from the mock.
failures.workaround_policy: Keep the supported translation enabled; no response rewrite in the rig.

failures.explanation: The shipped auto-protocol path converts Messages to Chat before the Cohere request adapter. Cohere emits a valid native reply, but its provider lacks response conversion to the Chat shape expected by the final Messages bridge, so the client does not receive valid Messages content.
failures.workaround_policy: Keep enabled; no fabricated Messages output.
